description.narrative:
IGNITE Niger is a 12-month integrated youth empowerment project targeting 300 young people (70%female) in Niger State, Nigeria. Theproject addresses three interconnected barriers facing youth: limited economic opportunities, poor health knowledge among girls, and gender-based violence.
Through our innovative three-pillar model, we will: 1. Train 300 youth in digital skills (data analytics, web development, graphic design) with 60% employment/income target 2. Reach 500 girls with health education onmenstrual hygiene, SRHR, and PCOS awareness 3. Train 50 community safety champions on GBV prevention
What makes IGNITE unique is its integrated approach,recognizing that girls cannot learn skills if they miss school due to period poverty or feel unsafe. By addressing economic, health, and safety barriers together, we create conditions for sustainable empowerment.
GOAL: Empower 300 youth (70% female) through integrated digital skills, health education, and GBV prevention.
OBJECTIVE 1: Train 300youth in digital skills 1. 3 eight-week Digital Skills Bootcamps 2. Mentorship and career guidance 3. Job linkages and freelance onboarding 4. Seed grants for 10 top entrepreneurs
OBJECTIVE 2: Improve health knowledge among 500 girls 1. Health workshops in 10 schools 2. Sanitary products for 300 girls (PAD a Girl) 3. Train 25 peer health educators 4. Establish 5 school-based Health Clubs 5. 2 PCOS awareness campaigns
OBJECTIVE 3: Strengthen community safety 1. Train 50 community safety champions 2. 5 GBV sensitization sessions 3. IEC materials development 4. Traditional leader engagement

participating-org.narrative:
VISION: A Nigeria where every young person, especially girls and women, has equal access to opportunities for economic empowerment,quality health education, and safety from violence.
MISSION: To empower youth and women in underserved communities through integrated digital skills training, health education, and gender-based violence prevention programming.
OBJECTIVES: - Equip youth with market-relevant digital skills for employment and entrepreneurship - Improve health knowledge and practices among girls and women - Reduce gender-based violence through community education and advocacy - Create sustainable community structures for ongoing youth empowerment
VALUES: - Youth Leadership: Young people lead solutions to challenges affecting their peers - Inclusion: Prioritizing marginalized groups, especially girls and rural youth - Integration: Addressing interconnected barriers through holistic programming - Sustainability: Building community capacity for lasting impact beyond projects - Integrity: Transparent, accountable stewardship of resources and relationships - Innovation: Embracing technology and creative approaches to social challenges
Founded in 2022, BCO has trained 1,250+ youth (85% female) with 40% employment rate, reached 465 girls with health education, and supported 50 youth-led businesses.
